method.country_note: Outlet country means origin. Source country means stated institutional/location association, not assumed citizenship. Unknown remains unknown.
method.claim_type_note: Fact claim means a checkable assertion, not an independently verified fact. Opinions, predictions, intentions and wording are separate.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a supporting claim to the claim receiving support. Grey comparisons have no assigned direction. Solid red arrows point from a source claim to a target claim it is proposed to contradict. Red direction follows the analyst-assigned comparison order. Every proposed conflict retains its reasoning and scope limits for human review.
method.attention_note: Attention is judged from the saved article body and paragraph allocation; it is not an outlet-wide bias score.
method.endorsement_note: Quoting a speaker is not endorsement. Outlet view is stated, inferred from wording, or not stated.
method.annotation_status: AI-assisted research example; proposed claim relations need human review.
method.excluded_claims: Other Donbas locations in the Kyiv brief and Izvestia’s mid-February blame claim are outside the narrow event comparison.
method.support_note: Support is an analyst-assigned relation between specific propositions, not political approval, article-to-article endorsement, verified truth, or proof of independent corroboration. An arrow may support only a named part of a compound claim. The reverse arrow is not implied.
method.direction_note: Supportive links use source claim → target claim. Logical contradiction is symmetric: if A and B cannot both be true under matching definitions, time and place, the incompatibility holds both ways. A one-way red challenge is appropriate only when a source explicitly denies or rebuts the matching target claim. None is established in this sample; no arbitrary red arrow is added.
method.scope_note: One event can contain different places, dates and claim types. Keep the city, wider pocket, two-city area, highway and bridge separate. Operational encirclement or a route under fire can coexist with an incomplete physical ring. An event-wide display does not remove these claim-level limits.
method.multigraph_note: Several distinct claim relations may join the same two outlet nodes. Each keeps its own ID, claim endpoints, direction, reason and limits. A link never summarizes the whole outlet.
